name: UseMyContext.ai
description:
UseMyContext is context you write yourself - your role, projects, preferences, and files - and approve every change to. Claude reads it on demand, so you never re-introduce yourself.

The same context also connects to ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity - one profile across every AI subscription you have, not locked in one of them.

Connect once and Claude can:
- Read your profile: a compact summary of who you are, built only from facts you have accepted.
- Answer from your own files: cited passages from your documents, and exact counts and totals from your spreadsheets - grounded answers, not guesses.
- Suggest updates as it learns about you, saved as pending items for your review. Nothing is written without your approval.
- Read contexts others have deliberately shared with you.

The one place on the web where you're in control. As a human. You write what goes in, you approve everything an AI proposes to remember, and you can revoke access in one click. Our  public servers cannot read your file content. One account, multiple projects, each with its own profile and files.

Free to start, and you don't need anything prepared: connect with an empty account and Claude interviews you right here in the chat to build your first profile. In Claude Code, npx usemycontext pull loads your context at the start of every session. Premium adds more projects and storage; Team adds a shared team context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add UseMyContext.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add UseMyContext.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.usemycontext.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the UseMyContext.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: UseMyContext.ai lists 13 MCP tools, including ask_docs, get_file, list_files, profile, query_table, search_files, shared_context, suggest_update, account, fetch, info, and list_profiles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to UseMyContext.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to UseMyContext.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
UseMyContext.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
UseMyContext.ai is developed by UseMyContext.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
